body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
This is a reminder that your invoice from @Order.OrderDate@ is available for payment.
You can quickly view, download, or pay your invoice through the Customer Portal.
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
If it’s your first time logging in, please use this temporary password:
@Customer.CustomerID@
After logging in:
Open My Account
Select Pay
Complete your payment
Need assistance?
Call us anytime Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214.
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
